card.name: Inside citations and reference numbers
card.fires_on: Small pieces inside scholarly citations and references, such as page markers (pp, p), page-range digits, years, author 'et al', and reference-number commas.

modes.label: Page markers

modes.label: Digits in references
modes.description: A digit inside a page range, year, or DOI in a reference list.

modes.label: Author and list punctuation
modes.description: 'et al' or a comma between cited numbers.
